text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Bamboo Memory
practicing her
dancing as I'm passing by
the lesson rooms.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And take that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her methodical choreography and
determined
expression are captivating.
However...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! So the choreography really doesn't
fit, huh?
choice_data_list: 軽快でさわやかな曲にその振りつけは……
choice_data_list_en: That choreography for such a light and refreshing song is...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My dance teacher said the same thing,
so I've
been trying to figure something
out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
But no matter how many times I change
it, it ends
up the same. I can't capture
the vibe of the song...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh! What should I do?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Relax? But how?
choice_data_list: リラックスして肩の力を抜こう
お手本になりそうな子のマネをしよう
choice_data_list_en: Just relax and ease the tension in your shoulders.
Let's copy someone who'd make a good role model.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Something funny, huh? Something
funny...
Hmmm... I mean, there should be
so many things
to choose from...
choice_data_list: 面白かったことを思い出してみるとか
choice_data_list_en: How about trying to remember something funny?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory seems totally lost. In
that case...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I cover my face with both hands and
then open
them to reveal a ridiculous
face!
choice_data_list: じゃあ俺が面白いことを作るよ！
じゃあ私が面白いことを作るよ！
choice_data_list_en: Then I'll come up with something fun!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Pfft! Hehe... What the heck kinda face is
that,
Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I don't know if "like" is the right word,
but...
choice_data_list: とっておきの変顔は気に入った？
choice_data_list_en: Did you like my special funny face?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! No fair, I wasn't ready!
That's against
the rules!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You've gotta stop! My abs can't take
any
more!
choice_data_list_en: There's another side to it, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After having some fun and loosening up,
Bamboo
Memory is finally able to match
her movements to
the song.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I see! So I should copy someone first!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Oguri seems like she'd make
the best
model out of everyone I know.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She's always so naturally calm. I think
she'd be a
perfect fit for this song!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I feel so at ease when I'm with her. In
fact, we
usually end up doing everything
at her speed—in
a good way!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
She's the same in her races too! She's so
free, but
so fast... Watching her really
tugs at the
heartstrings!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When she runs like that, I... I...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hrng... Yaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about her makes me want
to run so
bad!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer! I've got to run off all this
energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory dashes away to the
training
track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's not exactly what I planned, but after
she
releases all her pent-up energy, she
manages to
relax and dance along to the
song.
